name: Norge – nasjonale regler (trinnene fra regningen din)
assumed: § 14-2 of the regulation requires only that the fixed fee follows the customer's demand for power; the metric here – the mean of the month's three highest hourly maxima on three different days – is the model the Norwegian DSOs adopted on 2022-07-01, read on Elvia's and Tensio's own sheets, and the steps and fees are each DSO's own, asked from the household's bill.
